recipes.title: Slow-cooker pulled pork sandwiches
recipes.blurb: Fall-apart pork piled on buns with tangy barbecue sauce

steps.text: Mix the brown sugar, paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper. Rub it all over the pork.
Put the onion in the slow cooker, set the pork on top, and pour the broth around it.
Cover and cook on low until the pork falls apart easily with a fork.
Move the pork to a cutting board and shred it with two forks. Throw away big pieces of fat.
Pour off most of the liquid. Put the pork back and stir in the barbecue sauce.
Cover and warm on low so the sauce soaks in.
Pile onto buns and top with coleslaw if you like.

recipes.title: Oven baby back ribs
recipes.blurb: Dry-rubbed, slow-baked ribs glazed with sticky barbecue sauce

ingredients.item: racks baby back ribs (about 2 lb each)

steps.text: Heat the oven to 275°F. Pull the thin membrane off the back of each rack and pat the ribs dry.
Mix the sugar, paprika, chili powder, garlic powder, onion powder, salt and pepper. Rub on both sides.
Wrap each rack tightly in foil and set them on a baking sheet.
Bake until the meat is very tender and pulling back from the bones.
Heat the broiler. Unwrap the ribs, set them on the sheet, and brush with barbecue sauce.
Broil until the sauce bubbles and darkens. Watch closely.
Rest, then cut between the bones and serve with extra sauce.

recipes.title: Oven barbecue beef brisket
recipes.blurb: Tender sliced brisket braised low and slow in a tangy sauce

steps.text: Heat the oven to 300°F. Mix the paprika, sugar, chili powder, salt and pepper, and rub it over the brisket.
Scatter the onion and garlic in a roasting pan. Set the brisket on top, fat side up, and pour in the broth.
Cover the pan tightly with foil.
Roast until a fork slides into the meat with little resistance.
Rest the brisket on a cutting board, still covered.
Slice across the grain. Stir the barbecue sauce into the pan juices and spoon over the slices.

recipes.title: Grilled barbecue chicken
recipes.blurb: Juicy bone-in chicken grilled and brushed with sweet sauce

steps.text: Heat a grill to medium, with one hot side and one cooler side.
Rub the chicken with oil, paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper.
Grill on the cooler side, covered, turning once, until almost cooked through.
Brush the chicken with barbecue sauce and move it over the hot side.
Grill, turning and brushing, until the sauce is sticky and the chicken reaches 165°F.
Rest the chicken for 5 minutes and serve with the leftover sauce.

recipes.title: Slow-cooker BBQ pulled chicken
recipes.blurb: Easy shredded chicken in smoky sauce for sandwiches

steps.text: Mix the sauce, broth, sugar, vinegar, paprika, garlic powder and salt in the slow cooker.
Add the chicken and turn it to coat.
Cover and cook on low until the chicken is 165°F and tender.
Shred the chicken with two forks right in the pot.
Stir it into the sauce and let it soak up the flavor.
Spoon onto buns and serve.

recipes.title: Oven pork belly burnt ends
recipes.blurb: Crispy, sticky, caramelized cubes of pork belly

steps.text: Heat the oven to 275°F. Toss the pork cubes with the sugar, paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper.
Spread on a rack set over a baking sheet.
Bake until the cubes are browned and the fat has started to render.
Move the cubes to a foil pan. Add the sauce, honey and butter and toss to coat.
Cover the pan with foil.
Bake until the pork is very tender.
Uncover and bake until the sauce is thick and sticky.

recipes.title: Grilled BBQ pork chops
recipes.blurb: Thick chops with a quick rub and a sweet sauce glaze

steps.text: Heat a grill to medium-high.
Brush the chops with oil. Mix the sugar, paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper and rub it on.
Grill the chops, flipping once, until nearly done.
Brush both sides with barbecue sauce.
Grill, turning once, until the chops reach 145°F inside.
Rest the chops before serving.

recipes.title: Oven barbecue chicken wings
recipes.blurb: Crispy baked wings tossed in a smoky sauce

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Set a rack over a foil-lined baking sheet and spray it with cooking spray.
Pat the wings very dry. Toss with baking powder, paprika, garlic powder and salt.
Spread the wings on the rack in one layer.
Bake, flipping halfway, until crisp and 165°F inside.
Stir the sauce and honey together in a large bowl and toss the hot wings in it.
Return the wings to the rack and bake to set the glaze.

recipes.title: Grilled smoked sausage and peppers
recipes.blurb: Smoky sausage and sweet peppers charred on the grill

steps.text: Heat a grill to medium-high.
Toss the peppers and onion with oil, paprika and salt in a bowl.
Grill the vegetables in a grill basket, stirring now and then, until charred and tender.
Grill the sausage cut side down, then flip, until browned and hot all the way through.
Toast the rolls on the grill for a minute.
Fill the rolls with sausage and vegetables and drizzle with barbecue sauce.

recipes.title: Southern fried chicken
recipes.blurb: Buttermilk-soaked, crunchy and juicy to the bone

steps.text: Mix the chicken with the buttermilk and hot sauce. Cover and chill for at least 4 hours.
Whisk the flour, paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper in a wide dish. Dredge the chicken and press the flour on.
Heat 1 inch of oil in a large deep skillet to 325°F.
Fry in batches, skin side down first, turning once, until deep golden.
Check that the thickest pieces read 165°F. Drain on a rack.
Rest the chicken for a few minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Chicken-fried steak with cream gravy
recipes.blurb: Crispy cube steak under peppery white gravy

steps.text: Whisk the eggs with 1/2 cup milk. Mix 1 cup flour with the salt and half the pepper in a dish.
Dip each steak in flour, then egg, then flour again, pressing firmly.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry the steaks until deep golden on both sides, turning once. Move to a rack.
Pour off all but 1/4 cup of the oil. Whisk in 1/4 cup flour and cook until golden brown.
Whisk in 2 cups milk and the rest of the pepper. Simmer until thick.
Pour the gravy over the steaks and serve.

recipes.title: Smothered pork chops
recipes.blurb: Browned chops simmered in onion gravy until tender

steps.text: Mix the flour, paprika, salt and pepper in a dish. Coat the chops and shake off extra.
Brown the chops in hot oil in a large skillet, 3 minutes per side. Move to a plate.
Cook the onion in the same skillet until soft and golden. Add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Stir in 2 tablespoons of leftover flour from the dish, then the broth. Stir until it thickens.
Nestle the chops back in the gravy, cover, and turn the heat to low.
Simmer until the chops reach 145°F and are tender.

recipes.title: Cornmeal fried catfish
recipes.blurb: Crisp cornmeal crust with flaky, mild fish

steps.text: Soak the fillets in the buttermilk.
Mix the cornmeal, flour, paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper in a wide dish.
Heat 1 inch of oil in a deep skillet to 350°F.
Lift each fillet, let it drip, and press into the cornmeal mix to coat.
Fry in batches, turning once, until golden and flaking, 145°F inside.
Drain on a rack and serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Chicken and dumplings
recipes.blurb: Rolled biscuit dumplings in a rich chicken stew

steps.text: Melt 2 tablespoons butter in a large pot. Cook the onion, carrots and celery until softened.
Add the broth and chicken and bring to a boil.
Simmer until the chicken is 165°F. Shred it and return it to the pot.
Mix the flour, baking powder and salt. Cut in the cold butter, then stir in the milk to make a soft dough.
Roll the dough 1/4 inch thick and cut into 1-inch strips. Drop them into the simmering stew.
Cover and simmer until the dumplings are cooked through. Season with pepper.

recipes.title: Southern meatloaf with tangy glaze
recipes.blurb: Classic ground beef meatloaf with a ketchup-brown sugar top

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F.
Mix the beef, onion, garlic, breadcrumbs, eggs, milk, Worcestershire, salt, pepper and 1/4 cup ketchup.
Shape into a loaf on a foil-lined baking sheet.
Stir the remaining ketchup with the brown sugar and spread half over the loaf.
Bake for 40 minutes, then spread on the rest of the glaze.
Bake until the center reads 160°F.
Rest before slicing.

recipes.title: Shrimp and grits
recipes.blurb: Garlicky shrimp over creamy cheese grits

steps.text: Bring the water and 1 teaspoon salt to a boil. Whisk in the grits.
Turn to low, cover, and cook, stirring often, until thick and creamy.
Stir in the cheddar and butter. Keep covered.
Cook the bacon in a skillet until crisp. Lift out, leaving the fat.
Cook the shrimp with paprika in the bacon fat until pink.
Add the garlic for 30 seconds, then the lemon juice.
Spoon the grits into bowls, top with shrimp, bacon and scallions.

recipes.title: Fried green tomatoes
recipes.blurb: Tangy tomato slices in a crunchy cornmeal crust

steps.text: Salt the tomato slices lightly and lay them on paper towels.
Let the tomatoes drain, then pat dry.
Set up three dishes: flour; eggs mixed with buttermilk; cornmeal with salt and pepper.
Dredge each slice in flour, then egg, then cornmeal.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry in batches until golden on both sides. Drain on paper towels.
Stir the mayonnaise and hot sauce together and serve for dipping.

recipes.title: Hoppin John
recipes.blurb: Black-eyed peas, rice and smoky ham, a New Year tradition

steps.text: Rinse the peas and pick out any stones. Soak them in water for 1 hour, then drain.
Cook the bacon in a large pot until crisp. Add the onion, pepper and celery and cook until soft.
Stir in the garlic and thyme for 30 seconds.
Add the peas, broth and ham hock. Bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer until the peas are tender.
Cook the rice separately by the package directions.
Pull the meat off the hock and stir it in. Season with salt and pepper and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Chicken and sausage jambalaya
recipes.blurb: One-pot rice with andouille, chicken and the Cajun trinity

steps.text: Brown the sausage in oil in a large heavy pot, then lift it out.
Brown the chicken in the same pot for 5 minutes and lift it out.
Cook the onion, pepper and celery until soft. Add the garlic and Cajun seasoning.
Stir in the tomatoes, rice and broth. Add the meats back and bring to a boil.
Cover, turn to low, and cook without lifting the lid until the rice is tender.
Turn off the heat and let it steam. Stir in the scallions.

recipes.title: Shrimp etouffee
recipes.blurb: Shrimp smothered in a buttery roux sauce over rice

steps.text: Melt the butter in a Dutch oven over medium heat. Whisk in the flour.
Cook the roux, stirring constantly, until it is the color of peanut butter.
Add the onion, pepper and celery. Cook until soft, then stir in the garlic.
Whisk in the broth, tomatoes and Cajun seasoning.
Simmer the sauce until thickened.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink and curled.
Stir in the scallions and spoon over rice.

recipes.title: Blackened catfish
recipes.blurb: Spice-crusted fish seared in a hot skillet

steps.text: Mix the paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, thyme, cayenne, salt and pepper.
Pat the fish dry, brush with melted butter, and coat well with the spice mix.
Heat a cast-iron skillet over high heat until very hot. Open a window and run the vent.
Sear the fillets until a dark crust forms.
Flip and cook until the fish is 145°F and flakes easily.
Serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Shrimp creole
recipes.blurb: Shrimp in a spicy tomato and vegetable sauce over rice

steps.text: Melt the butter in a large skillet. Cook the onion, pepper and celery until soft.
Add the garlic and cook 30 seconds.
Stir in the tomatoes, broth, Cajun seasoning and bay leaves.
Simmer, partly covered, until the sauce thickens.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink. Remove the bay leaves.
Serve over rice with scallions on top.

recipes.title: Cajun dirty rice
recipes.blurb: Rice cooked with seasoned ground meat and trinity vegetables

steps.text: Brown the sausage and beef in a large pot until no pink remains. Drain off extra fat.
Add the onion, pepper and celery and cook until soft. Stir in the garlic and Cajun seasoning.
Add the rice and stir for 1 minute. Pour in the broth and bring to a boil.
Cover, turn to low, and cook until the rice is tender.
Rest, covered, then fluff with a fork.
Stir in the scallions.

recipes.title: Creamy Cajun chicken pasta
recipes.blurb: Spiced chicken and peppers in a cream sauce with penne

steps.text: Boil the pasta in salted water until tender, then drain.
Toss the chicken with 1 teaspoon Cajun seasoning.
Cook the chicken in oil until browned and 165°F inside. Lift it out.
Cook the pepper in the pan for 3 minutes. Add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Pour in the cream and the rest of the seasoning. Simmer until slightly thick.
Stir in the parmesan, chicken and pasta. Top with scallions.

recipes.title: Red beans and rice
recipes.blurb: Creamy slow-simmered kidney beans with smoked sausage

steps.text: Rinse the beans, cover with water and soak overnight. Drain.
Brown the sausage in oil in a big pot. Add the onion, pepper and celery and cook until soft.
Stir in the garlic, bay leaves and Cajun seasoning.
Add the beans and 7 cups water. Bring to a boil.
Simmer, partly covered, stirring now and then, until the beans are very tender.
Mash some beans against the pot to make it creamy. Remove the bay leaves, season, and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Blackened chicken breasts
recipes.blurb: Cajun-spiced chicken seared with a dark crust

steps.text: Mix the paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, oregano, cayenne and salt.
Pat the chicken dry and coat both sides with the spice mix.
Heat the oil in a cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook the chicken until a dark crust forms.
Flip and cook until the chicken reads 165°F.
Rest for a few minutes, then serve with lemon.

recipes.title: Cajun shrimp and sausage boil
recipes.blurb: Shrimp, sausage, corn and potatoes in spicy broth

steps.text: Bring the water, seasoning, lemon and garlic to a boil in a large pot.
Add the potatoes and boil until nearly tender.
Add the sausage and corn and boil.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink. Drain well.
Pour onto a newspaper-lined table, drizzle with melted butter and sprinkle with seasoning.

recipes.title: Chicken and sausage gumbo
recipes.blurb: Dark roux gumbo with andouille and tender chicken

steps.text: Whisk the oil and flour in a Dutch oven over medium heat.
Cook the roux, stirring nonstop, until it is the color of chocolate.
Stir in the onion, pepper and celery. Cook until soft, then add the garlic.
Slowly stir in the broth. Add the chicken, sausage, seasoning and bay leaves.
Simmer, partly covered, until the chicken is 165°F and tender.
Shred the chicken, return it to the pot, and remove the bay leaves. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Brunswick stew
recipes.blurb: Smoky pulled meat, corn and beans in a tomato stew

steps.text: Cook the onion in oil in a large pot until soft.
Add the tomatoes, broth, barbecue sauce, Worcestershire and hot sauce.
Stir in the pork, chicken, corn and lima beans.
Bring to a boil, then turn down and simmer, stirring now and then, until thick.
Taste and add salt and pepper. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Texas beef chili (no beans)
recipes.blurb: Chunky beef in a deep red chile sauce

steps.text: Brown the beef in batches in 2 tablespoons hot oil in a Dutch oven. Set aside.
Cook the onion in the last tablespoon of oil until soft. Add the garlic, chili powder, cumin and oregano for 1 minute.
Add the tomato sauce, broth, beef and 1 teaspoon salt.
Cover and simmer on low until the beef is tender.
Stir the masa harina with 1/4 cup water and mix into the chili.
Simmer uncovered until thick. Add salt to taste.

recipes.title: Ham and bean soup
recipes.blurb: Navy beans simmered with a ham bone and vegetables

steps.text: Rinse the beans and soak them overnight in water. Drain.
Put the beans, ham bone, onion, carrots, celery, garlic, 8 cups water and bay leaves in a big pot.
Bring to a boil.
Turn to low, cover partly, and simmer until the beans are tender.
Pull out the bone, shred the meat and return it. Stir in the diced ham and pepper.
Simmer to heat the ham. Remove bay leaves, taste, and serve.

recipes.title: Southern beef stew
recipes.blurb: Beef, potatoes and carrots in a rich gravy

steps.text: Toss the beef with the flour, 1 teaspoon salt and some pepper.
Brown the beef in hot oil in a Dutch oven in batches. Set aside.
Cook the onion until soft. Add the garlic and tomato paste for 1 minute.
Add the broth, Worcestershire and beef. Bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer on low until the beef is nearly tender.
Add the potatoes and carrots and simmer until tender.

recipes.title: Southern corn chowder
recipes.blurb: Creamy chowder with sweet corn, bacon and potatoes

steps.text: Cook the bacon in a large pot until crisp. Lift out and keep 2 tablespoons of fat.
Cook the onion and celery in the fat until soft. Stir in the flour for 1 minute.
Whisk in the broth. Add the potatoes and bring to a boil.
Simmer until the potatoes are tender.
Add the corn, milk and cream. Mash a few potatoes to thicken.
Simmer gently, do not boil. Season, and top with bacon.

recipes.title: Black-eyed pea and sausage soup
recipes.blurb: Hearty peas with smoked sausage and greens

steps.text: Brown the sausage in oil in a large pot. Lift it out.
Cook the onion and carrots until soft. Add the garlic and paprika.
Add the peas, broth and sausage. Bring to a boil.
Simmer to blend the flavors.
Stir in the greens and cook until tender.
Add the vinegar, salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Baked mac and cheese
recipes.blurb: Creamy cheddar sauce under a crisp breadcrumb top

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Butter a 9x13 baking dish.
Boil the macaroni in salted water 2 minutes less than the package says. Drain.
In the same pot, melt 4 tablespoons butter over medium heat. Whisk in the flour and cook for 1 minute.
Slowly whisk in the milk. Keep stirring until it thickens.
Turn off the heat. Stir in 2 cups cheese, the salt and garlic powder, then the macaroni.
Pour into the dish. Top with the last cup of cheese, then breadcrumbs mixed with melted butter.
Bake until bubbly and golden on top.
Let it cool a few minutes before serving. It will be very hot.

recipes.title: Southern collard greens
recipes.blurb: Tender greens simmered low with smoked turkey and vinegar

steps.text: Wash the collards well in a sink of water, then drain.
Put the turkey wing, onion, garlic, broth and red pepper flakes in a large pot and bring to a boil.
Simmer the turkey to flavor the broth.
Add the collards in handfuls, stirring as they wilt.
Cover and simmer until very tender.
Stir in the vinegar, sugar and salt. Pull the meat off the wing, chop it, and stir it in.

recipes.title: Southern green beans with bacon
recipes.blurb: Slow-cooked green beans in a smoky bacon broth

steps.text: Cook the bacon in a large pot until crisp. Lift out with a slotted spoon.
Cook the onion in the bacon fat until soft.
Add the beans, broth, sugar, salt and pepper.
Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer on low until tender.
Stir the bacon back in and serve.

recipes.title: Candied yams
recipes.blurb: Sweet potatoes baked in a brown sugar, butter and cinnamon glaze

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Spread the sweet potatoes in a 9x13 baking dish.
Whisk the butter, brown sugar, water, cinnamon, nutmeg, vanilla and salt. Pour over the potatoes.
Cover the dish tightly with foil.
Bake, covered.
Uncover and spoon the syrup over the potatoes.
Bake uncovered, basting once, until tender and glazed.

recipes.title: Creamy Southern coleslaw
recipes.blurb: Crunchy cabbage in a sweet-tangy dressing

steps.text: Put the cabbage and carrots in a large bowl.
Whisk the mayonnaise, vinegar, sugar, mustard, celery seed, salt and pepper.
Pour the dressing over the cabbage and toss well.
Chill so the flavors blend and the cabbage softens.
Toss again, taste, and adjust the salt.

recipes.title: Southern potato salad
recipes.blurb: Creamy potato salad with eggs, pickle and mustard

steps.text: Boil the potatoes in salted water until just tender. Drain and cool.
Hard-boil the eggs in a separate pot, then cool in cold water.
Peel and chop the eggs.
Whisk the mayonnaise, mustard, relish, vinegar, salt and pepper.
Gently fold in the potatoes, eggs, celery and onion.
Chill. Sprinkle with paprika before serving.

recipes.title: Southern baked beans
recipes.blurb: Sweet and smoky beans baked with bacon and molasses

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F.
Cook the bacon and onion in a skillet until the bacon is crisp and the onion soft.
Mix the beans, ketchup, sugar, molasses, mustard and Worcestershire in a 2-quart baking dish.
Stir in the bacon mixture.
Bake uncovered, stirring once, until thick and bubbling.
Let the beans rest to thicken before serving.

recipes.title: Creamy cheese grits
recipes.blurb: Slow-cooked stone-ground grits with sharp cheddar

steps.text: Bring the water, milk and salt to a gentle boil.
Slowly whisk in the grits so no lumps form.
Turn to low, cover, and cook, stirring often, until thick and creamy.
Stir in the butter, then the cheese until melted.
Add pepper, taste for salt, and serve hot.

recipes.title: Cornmeal fried okra
recipes.blurb: Crispy golden okra bites with a cornmeal crust

steps.text: Toss the okra with the buttermilk in a bowl.
Mix the cornmeal, flour, salt, pepper and garlic powder in a bag or dish.
Lift the okra out with a slotted spoon, letting extra buttermilk drip, and toss in the cornmeal mix.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high until shimmering.
Fry in batches, turning, until golden and crisp.
Drain on paper towels, add a pinch of salt, and serve hot.

recipes.title: Buttermilk biscuits
recipes.blurb: Tall, flaky, buttery biscuits

steps.text: Heat the oven to 450°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, salt and sugar. Cut in the cold butter until pea-size pieces remain.
Stir in the buttermilk just until the dough comes together.
Pat the dough on a floured counter to 1 inch thick. Fold it in thirds twice, then pat out to 1 inch.
Cut with a floured 2.5-inch cutter, pushing straight down. Set the biscuits touching on the sheet.
Bake until tall and golden brown.
Brush the tops with melted butter.

recipes.title: Skillet buttermilk cornbread
recipes.blurb: Crisp-edged cornbread baked in a hot cast-iron skillet

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Put a 10-inch cast-iron skillet with 2 tablespoons butter inside to melt.
Whisk the cornmeal, flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt.
Whisk the buttermilk and eggs, then stir into the dry mix. Add 2 tablespoons melted butter.
Swirl the hot skillet to coat, then pour in the batter. It should sizzle.
Bake until golden and a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool a few minutes, then slice into wedges.

recipes.title: Hushpuppies
recipes.blurb: Crispy fried cornmeal balls with onion

steps.text: Whisk the cornmeal, flour, baking powder, salt and sugar.
Stir in the onion, egg and buttermilk to make a thick batter.
Rest the batter.
Heat 2 inches of oil in a deep pot to 350°F.
Drop in rounded tablespoons of batter, a few at a time. Fry, turning, until deep golden.
Drain on paper towels and serve warm.

recipes.title: Biscuits and sausage gravy
recipes.blurb: Fluffy biscuits under peppery sausage gravy

steps.text: Brown the sausage in a large skillet, breaking it up, until no pink remains.
Sprinkle the flour over the sausage and stir for 1 minute.
Slowly pour in the milk, stirring. Simmer until thick.
Stir in the pepper, then taste and add salt.
Split the biscuits and ladle the gravy over them.

recipes.title: Cornbread muffins
recipes.blurb: Sweet-tender cornbread baked in a muffin tin

steps.text: Heat the oven to 400°F. Grease a 12-cup muffin tin with cooking spray.
Whisk the cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.
Whisk the milk, egg and oil, then stir into the dry mix until just combined.
Divide the batter among the muffin cups, filling them two-thirds full.
Bake until golden and a toothpick comes out clean.
Brush with honey and serve warm.

recipes.title: Easy cheddar drop biscuits
recipes.blurb: No-roll biscuits with sharp cheddar

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, salt and garlic powder. Cut in the butter until crumbly.
Stir in the cheddar, then the buttermilk, just until combined.
Drop heaping 1/4-cup scoops of dough onto the sheet, 2 inches apart.
Bake until golden brown on top.
Cool a couple of minutes and serve warm.

recipes.title: Jalapeno cheddar cornbread
recipes.blurb: Spicy, cheesy skillet cornbread

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Put a 10-inch cast-iron skillet in the oven to heat.
Whisk the cornmeal, flour, baking powder and salt.
Whisk the buttermilk, eggs and melted butter. Stir into the dry mix.
Fold in the cheddar and jalapenos.
Carefully spoon the batter into the hot greased skillet.
Bake until golden and a toothpick comes out clean.

recipes.title: Cheddar garlic biscuits
recipes.blurb: Buttery biscuits with a garlic butter brush

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, salt and garlic powder. Cut in the cold butter until crumbly.
Stir in the cheddar and buttermilk to make a shaggy dough.
Pat the dough to 1 inch thick on a floured counter and cut 8 rounds.
Bake until golden.
Stir the melted butter with the garlic and parsley and brush over the hot biscuits.

recipes.title: Southern hoecakes
recipes.blurb: Pan-fried cornmeal cakes with crisp edges

steps.text: Whisk the cornmeal, flour, baking powder, salt and sugar.
Stir in the buttermilk and egg until just mixed.
Let the batter rest to thicken.
Melt a little butter in a skillet over medium heat.
Spoon in 1/4-cup rounds. Cook until the edges are crisp and bubbles show, then flip and cook the other side.
Serve warm with butter or syrup.

recipes.title: Sweet potato biscuits
recipes.blurb: Soft, lightly sweet biscuits with a golden color

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, salt, brown sugar and cinnamon. Cut in the butter until crumbly.
Stir in the mashed sweet potato and milk until a soft dough forms.
Pat the dough 3/4 inch thick on a floured counter and cut with a 2-inch cutter.
Bake until puffed and golden brown on the bottoms.
Brush with honey while hot.
